verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only human-operated electronic filing routes: DPMAdirektWeb, the downloadable DPMAdirektPro client used with a personal signature card, and paper or fax. Nothing shows a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, certified transmitter programs for third-party software, batch providers, or a published enrollment path for software integrators. A machine-transaction channel is a fair axis for an IP office, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
